schema.help: Think of traffic lights, zebra crossings, footbridges or underpasses near the stops you use.

options.text: I avoid some stops because crossing to them feels unsafe
I often feel unsafe when I cross
I sometimes go a longer way to cross more safely
I feel safe, but I have to be careful
I feel safe: the crossings are well protected

schema.text: When you cross the road to reach or leave a stop, how safe do you feel?

ar.#I avoid some stops because crossing to: أتجنب بعض المحطات لأن العبور إليها لا يبدو آمنًا
ar.#I feel safe, but I have to be careful: أشعر بالأمان، لكن عليّ أن أكون حذرًا
ar.#I often feel unsafe when I cross: أشعر غالبًا بعدم الأمان عند العبور
ar.#I sometimes go a longer way to cross mo: أسلك أحيانًا طريقًا أطول لأعبر بأمان أكبر
ar.#Think of traffic lights, zebra crossing: فكّر في إشارات المرور وممرات المشاة والجسور أو الأنفاق قرب المحطات التي تستخدمها.
ar.#When you cross the road to reach or lea: عندما تعبر الطريق للوصول إلى المحطة أو مغادرتها، ما مدى شعورك بالأمان؟

de.#I avoid some stops because crossing to: Ich meide manche Haltestellen, weil mir das Überqueren dorthin unsicher vorkommt
de.#I feel safe, but I have to be careful: Ich fühle mich sicher, muss aber aufpassen
de.#I feel safe: the crossings are well pro: Ich fühle mich sicher: Die Übergänge sind gut gesichert
de.#I often feel unsafe when I cross: Ich fühle mich beim Überqueren oft unsicher
de.#I sometimes go a longer way to cross mo: Manchmal gehe ich einen Umweg, um sicherer zu überqueren
de.#Think of traffic lights, zebra crossing: Denken Sie an Ampeln, Zebrastreifen, Fußgängerbrücken oder Unterführungen bei den Haltestellen, die Sie nutzen.
de.#When you cross the road to reach or lea: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich, wenn Sie die Straße überqueren, um zu einer Haltestelle zu kommen oder sie zu verlassen?

en.#I avoid some stops because crossing to: I avoid some stops because crossing to them feels unsafe
en.#I feel safe, but I have to be careful: I feel safe, but I have to be careful
en.#I feel safe: the crossings are well pro: I feel safe: the crossings are well protected
en.#I often feel unsafe when I cross: I often feel unsafe when I cross

en.#Think of traffic lights, zebra crossing: Think of traffic lights, zebra crossings, footbridges or underpasses near the stops you use.

fa.#I avoid some stops because crossing to: از بعضی ایستگاه‌ها دوری می‌کنم چون عبور به آن‌ها ناامن است
fa.#I feel safe, but I have to be careful: احساس امنیت می‌کنم، اما باید مراقب باشم
fa.#I feel safe: the crossings are well pro: احساس امنیت می‌کنم: گذرگاه‌ها خوب محافظت شده‌اند
fa.#I often feel unsafe when I cross: اغلب هنگام عبور احساس ناامنی می‌کنم
fa.#I sometimes go a longer way to cross mo: گاهی برای عبور امن‌تر مسیر طولانی‌تری می‌روم
fa.#Think of traffic lights, zebra crossing: به چراغ راهنمایی، خط عابر پیاده، پل هوایی یا زیرگذر نزدیک ایستگاه‌هایی که استفاده می‌کنید فکر کنید.
fa.#When you cross the road to reach or lea: وقتی برای رسیدن به ایستگاه یا ترک آن از جاده عبور می‌کنید، چقدر احساس امنیت می‌کنید؟

fr.#I avoid some stops because crossing to: J'évite certains arrêts parce que les traverser pour les rejoindre me semble dangereux
fr.#I feel safe, but I have to be careful: Je me sens en sécurité, mais je dois faire attention
fr.#I feel safe: the crossings are well pro: Je me sens en sécurité : les passages sont bien protégés
fr.#I often feel unsafe when I cross: Je me sens souvent en danger quand je traverse
fr.#I sometimes go a longer way to cross mo: Je fais parfois un détour pour traverser plus sûrement
fr.#Think of traffic lights, zebra crossing: Pensez aux feux, aux passages piétons, aux passerelles ou aux passages souterrains près des arrêts que vous utilisez.
fr.#When you cross the road to reach or lea: Quand vous traversez la route pour rejoindre ou quitter un arrêt, à quel point vous sentez-vous en sécurité ?

hu.#I avoid some stops because crossing to: Egyes megállókat elkerülök, mert nem érzem biztonságosnak az odajutást
hu.#I feel safe, but I have to be careful: Biztonságban érzem magam, de óvatosnak kell lennem
hu.#I feel safe: the crossings are well pro: Biztonságban érzem magam: az átkelők jól védettek
hu.#I often feel unsafe when I cross: Átkelés közben gyakran nem érzem magam biztonságban
hu.#I sometimes go a longer way to cross mo: Néha hosszabb utat teszek meg, hogy biztonságosabban kelhessek át
hu.#Think of traffic lights, zebra crossing: Gondoljon a lámpákra, zebrákra, gyalogos-felüljárókra vagy aluljárókra az Ön által használt megállók közelében.
hu.#When you cross the road to reach or lea: Amikor átkel az úton, hogy elérjen egy megállót vagy elhagyja azt, mennyire érzi magát biztonságban?

it.#I avoid some stops because crossing to: Evito alcune fermate perché attraversare per raggiungerle non mi sembra sicuro
it.#I feel safe, but I have to be careful: Mi sento sicuro, ma devo stare attento
it.#I feel safe: the crossings are well pro: Mi sento sicuro: gli attraversamenti sono ben protetti
it.#I often feel unsafe when I cross: Spesso mi sento poco sicuro quando attraverso
it.#I sometimes go a longer way to cross mo: A volte faccio un giro più lungo per attraversare in modo più sicuro
it.#Think of traffic lights, zebra crossing: Pensa a semafori, strisce pedonali, passerelle o sottopassi vicino alle fermate che usi.
it.#When you cross the road to reach or lea: Quando attraversi la strada per raggiungere o lasciare una fermata, quanto ti senti sicuro?

tr.#I avoid some stops because crossing to: Bazı duraklardan kaçınırım çünkü oraya geçmek güvensiz geliyor
tr.#I feel safe, but I have to be careful: Kendimi güvende hissederim ama dikkatli olmam gerekir
tr.#I feel safe: the crossings are well pro: Kendimi güvende hissederim: Geçitler iyi korunuyor
tr.#I often feel unsafe when I cross: Karşıya geçerken sık sık kendimi güvende hissetmem
tr.#I sometimes go a longer way to cross mo: Bazen daha güvenli geçmek için daha uzun bir yol izlerim
tr.#Think of traffic lights, zebra crossing: Kullandığınız durakların yakınındaki trafik ışıklarını, yaya geçitlerini, üst geçitleri veya alt geçitleri düşünün.
tr.#When you cross the road to reach or lea: Bir durağa gitmek veya durağdan ayrılmak için yolu geçerken kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
